curriculum.objective: Identify and classify familiar living and non-living things.
curriculum.instruction: Look at each picture. Write its number in the correct group.
curriculum.evidence: Child classifies six numbered pictures and explains one choice.
curriculum.teacher_facilitation: Ask whether each thing grows, breathes or needs food, then let the child classify it.
teacher_questions: Why does this belong in that group?
curriculum.parent_home_activity: No home task is assigned on this classroom page.
curriculum.parent_conversation: No home task is assigned on this classroom page.
curriculum.scene: Exactly six isolated objects in a strict three-column by two-row extraction grid: dog, tree, butterfly; rock, car, book.
curriculum.focal_point: Six clean assets for a numbered Living and Non-living classification activity.

illustration_asset_prompt:
BCube Phase 2 Illustration Asset Prompt — ST-LKG-V4-P010

Create exactly six unique isolated picture assets on a pure white background in a strict three-column by two-row grid with wide white gutters. Top row from left to right: dog, tree, butterfly. Bottom row from left to right: rock, car, book. Each appears exactly once. Keep every object fully visible, uncropped, centred in its cell and similar in perceived visual weight. Use premium LKG publishing quality, thick rounded outlines, correct anatomy and object structure, subtle shading and strong separation. No extra objects, child, teacher, classroom, Star mascot, words, labels, category headings, numbers, sorting bins, cards, borders, worksheet layout or completed answer.
